[Verse 1]
[Cm]Right outside of this one church town There's a
[Eb]gold dirt road to a whole lot of nothin' Got a
[F]deed to the land, but it ain't my ground This is
[Cm]God's country
We pray for rain, and thank Him when it's fallen 'Cause
[Eb]it brings a grain and a little bit of money We put
[F]it back in the plate I guess that's why they call it
[Cm]God's country

[Chorus]
[Cm]I saw the light in the sunrise Sittin'
[Eb]back in the fourty on the muddy riverside Gettin'
[F]baptized in holy water and shine With the
[Cm]dogs runnin' Saved
by the sound of the been found Dixie
[Eb]whistled in the wind, that'll get you Heaven bound The de-
[F]vil went down to Georgia, but he didn't stick around This is
[Cm]God's country

[Verse 2]
[Cm]We turned the dirt and worked until the week's done
[Eb]We take a break and break bread on Sunday And then
[F]do it all again 'Cause we're proud to be from
[Cm]God's country
